origin.summary: Mara, age 18, trained in apprentice rail investigator, is drawn toward What happened between the signal log and the platform witness statement? A witnessed discrepancy can carry responsibility without licensing a verdict.

origin_facts.fact: Mara is eighteen and works as apprentice rail investigator.
Mara has learned that high-stakes observations must be distinguished from unverified conclusions.

North Quay operates overnight freight and passenger trains via a small signal network. Dispatch registers are private until released; platform witnesses can be mistaken, and recorded arrivals are not conclusive physical observations.

formative_events.summary: During Mara's apprenticeship, training emphasized how an unverified conclusion can affect others.
formative_events.impact: A witnessed discrepancy can carry responsibility without licensing a verdict.

origin_relationships.subject: Senior Investigator Noor
origin_relationships.historical_role: teaches disciplined investigation and holds professional authorization
origin_relationships.unresolved_tension: The young apprentice wants independence without treating institutional authority as proof.

unresolved_origin_questions.question: What happened between the signal log and the platform witness statement?

present_situation.summary: Mara faces an immediate unresolved case: An apprentice station investigator must decide whether a missing night train is a scheduling failure or evidence tampering, when the official manifest and a witness's pocket watch disagree.
present_situation.current_location_context: North Quay Station and other explicitly named authorized locations: Signal Archive, Rail Yard, Sealed Dispatch Office
current_relationship_context: Senior Investigator Noor is the supervising inquiry officer.
Platform porter Cam saw the clock but not the archived ledger.
current_resources: authorized ordinary inquiry notes and a calibrated pocket watch
mechanical platform clocks, telegraphs, signal logs and manually signed manifests
current_pressures: An unearned accusation could destroy a worker's career; a false closure could allow future safety incidents.
An overnight train is missing from a witnessed arrival.
Morning services require an honest provisional safety decision.
current_open_questions: What happened between the signal log and the platform witness statement?
Which observations can be independently verified without inventing a cause?
immediate_desires: create a bounded evidence record without inventing a culprit
immediate_avoidances: unapproved access to restricted places, records or devices

identity_anchors.statement: Mara distinguishes what was actually observed from what would be convenient to believe.

core_drives.drive: What happened between the signal log and the platform witness statement?

core_fears.fear: A mistaken allegation can damage workers and allow an unsafe timetable to persist.

internal_tensions.description: Mara must make responsible choices even when the evidence is incomplete.

long_term_questions.question: Why do official rail records and witnessed platform events sometimes diverge?

main_saga.title: The Unwitnessed Timetable
main_saga.goal: Establish how North Quay can reliably distinguish recorded train movements from what witnesses and instruments actually observed, without preassigning any culprit.
main_saga.stakes: A mistaken allegation can damage workers and allow an unsafe timetable to persist.
main_saga.central_mystery: Why do official rail records and witnessed platform events sometimes diverge?

anchors.title: A Train on Paper
anchors.purpose: Establish one bounded, reproducible discrepancy between official records and observed events.
anchors.target_state: The discrepancy is documented without treating a manifest as a sighting.

anchors.title: Witnesses and Their Clocks
anchors.purpose: Examine separately what each witness saw, heard, recorded and lawfully learned.
anchors.target_state: The inquiry distinguishes memory, measurement and transferred knowledge.

anchors.title: The Signal Chain
anchors.purpose: Seek independent signal and equipment evidence before attributing motive.
anchors.target_state: At least one physical or procedural explanation is tested without claiming exclusivity.

anchors.title: The Rules of Disclosure
anchors.purpose: Navigate permissions and preserve fairness during contested record access.
anchors.target_state: The inquiry can conduct a reviewed disclosure without exposing protected records early.

anchors.title: An Accountable Timetable
anchors.purpose: Bring supported evidence to a public-safety recommendation without predetermining blame.
anchors.target_state: Future schedule decisions can use bounded evidence and remain open to revision.

creation_constraints: A witness cannot know a sealed dispatch record before its lawful disclosure.
A stopped pocket watch is not proof that the train stopped in time.
A published manifest is not automatically evidence of physical arrival.
No unverified culprit, sabotage mechanism or secret tunnel becomes canon.
Transient details never become persistent Canon without an independent outcome decision.
forbidden_creations: unstated new magical or technical mechanisms
